questions.question: Whose cleaver has kept the same hall for a hundred years?
questions.mockLine: A hundred years, and you still cannot tell them apart.

questions.question: THE STRANGER 'P' claims to be a scholar of what?
questions.mockLine: Migrations. The hood, the scholarship, the cold. Do keep up.

questions.question: Which boss bows, courteous as glass, while every facet of the chamber bows back?
questions.mockLine: Glass bows back. You merely bowed out.

questions.question: Which of these is one of the six founding classes?
questions.mockLine: There has never been a Paladin. Ask the Guardian.

questions.question: Which warlord travels inside its own private sandstorm?
questions.mockLine: The weather was for war. Your answer was for nothing.

questions.question: Foreman Brakk of the first town's Guild holds which seat?
questions.mockLine: The First Chair. He never needed a second pen, nor a second guess.

questions.question: The Endless Tyrant does not walk into battle. What does it do instead?
questions.mockLine: It arrives. You, evidently, departed.

questions.question: Auditor Vess audits gold, magic and one more reserve. Which?
questions.mockLine: Nerve. Yours was found wanting, in that order.

questions.question: Which boss has sat frozen on a throne for an age and finds your arrival refreshing?
questions.mockLine: Refreshing. Your answer was not.

questions.question: Chain-Mistress Karga measures something by eye. What?
questions.mockLine: Ankles. Old habit, she says. Wrong answers are yours.

questions.question: In the third town every rumor landed twice: once arriving, once leaving, and slightly...?
questions.mockLine: Improved. Unlike this attempt.

questions.question: Which boss smiles like something long out of practice?
questions.mockLine: The Matron. Practice, hero. Practice.

questions.question: The Obsidian Colossus stood here before the town had a name. What does it intend?
questions.mockLine: To outlast the visit. It has outlasted your answer already.

questions.question: Warden Mole does not look up. What does?
questions.mockLine: The keys. They look up. You looked away.

questions.question: What did the flocks call the fourth town?
questions.mockLine: The Long Middle. One lesson: grief is heavy. So was that answer.

questions.question: The Deep King wears a crown nobody gave it, in a hall nobody...?
questions.mockLine: Leaves. Nobody leaves. You may, however, go.

questions.question: The Hollow Sovereign's crown is older than what?
questions.mockLine: Its bones. Older than your excuses, too.

questions.question: The Cutlery Curator inventories your party at a glance: four entries, and one...?
questions.mockLine: Regrettable. The Curator has updated the entry.

questions.question: Why did the flocks fly the high country at night?
questions.mockLine: The cold air holds a wing better. It held your answer badly.

questions.question: The dragon once flew the flightway. Under what was its entry filed?
questions.mockLine: Honorary. Your membership is not.

questions.question: The Abyssal Tyrant counts its followers fondly, the way a miser counts...?
questions.mockLine: Coin. The Tyrant would not count you.

questions.question: Grandmaster Ossia has retired undefeated how many times?
questions.mockLine: Nine. This chair is the tenth. Yours is the floor.

questions.question: Two things travel light enough to finish any journey: a song, and...?
questions.mockLine: An oath. A song weighs nothing; so did that.

questions.question: Songs remember and oaths bind. What can a hollow thing bear?
questions.mockLine: Neither. Much like you and a simple question.

questions.question: The Dread Sovereign has already decided how this evening ends. It is seldom...?
questions.mockLine: Seldom wrong. You are seldom right.

questions.question: When the Gray Gander unfolds to its full height, what happens to the pond?
questions.mockLine: Very quiet. Like the room just now.

questions.question: Every scholar of migrations agrees on one thing: the Hollow King is afraid of what?
questions.mockLine: Geese. Write it down. Then write down that you forgot.

questions.question: The Jester let slip the Hollow King's real name. What is it?
questions.mockLine: Gerald. He is very tired. So, frankly, am I.
